## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused on a single concern and has a descriptive title
- [ ] Tests are added or updated and pass locally
- [ ] Docs are updated where needed (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/`)

- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included
- [ ] No debug leftovers (e.g. stray logging, commented-out code)
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included
